attempted_claim: Let η be chordal SLE_6 in the upper half-plane H from 0 to infinity. Let G be the graph whose vertices are the connected components (bubbles) of H \ η, where two vertices are joined by an edge when the boundaries of the corresponding components intersect. Is G almost surely connected?
